pages.name: Frostmite
pages.text: $(bold)Threat:$() variable. One is an irritation. $(danger)Ten is a thermal failure event.$()

pages.title: Field Notes
pages.text: $(li)Latch on and drag your temperature down; drain stacks to a severe cap$(li)Swarm lit heaters: less warmth, faster fuel burn$(li)Spawn late and burst from infested cold blocks when mined$(li)Fast, erratic, relentless

pages.title: Counters
pages.text: $(li)Don't let them stack$(li)A lit heater draws them off you; then guard it$(li)A full EVA suit blocks the drain on you$(li)Expect them in late packed or blue ice$(li)$(l:heating/miteaway)MiteAway$(/l) smoke keeps them out of a room

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Snowball.$(br2)$(flavor)Do not call them ice silverfish. That phrase has preceded several deaths.$()
